_about: How Amass tells whether a name found in a person's field (a registration contact's name, a document's author, a photo's artist) names a person, an organization or a role. A legal form (org_names.json) or an institution word (the entity_forms of document_leads.json) makes it an organization, except the institution words listed in surname_forms, which are also family names ('Sarah Church') and only make the name uncertain. person_titles before a name and a middle initial are evidence of a person. A name holding one of role_words names a job or a mailbox ('Domain Administrator', 'Hostmaster'), not anyone. Words are compared lower-cased, without surrounding punctuation.
